title: Jumper: platforms
description: Steer the figure with ←/→ or A/D and jump onto the platforms with the space bar or ↑. Collect all three coins. Gravity is programmed by hand: tempo_y grows every frame.

tasks.text: Start with Continue and collect all three coins (the world has to be clicked).
Jump higher: change the number in self.tempo_y = -11.
Add a fourth platform and a coin on it in main.py.
Add a class Stachel that sends the figure back to the start when touched.

tasks: Play with gravity: what happens with self.tempo_y += 0.3 or += 1.2?
